book.name: 2 Kolɛŋ
book.title: Ŋwa wù kiŋgane kinfɛɛ wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ kintaashɛ ki Kolɛŋ le

content: Baŋgɛ ba Bol wù mwa ntuŋ wu Jiso Kletu gɛ̀ yɛne
No bee lɛne yi kintaashɛ le besa Nyo, bee mo kude chiaaŋ tɛ fɛ bɛŋ le lɛ keefɛ bɛŋ fɛ̂ fitele fì joŋe fì Nyo kɛme fɛ bɛŋ le ge fi lɛsɛ achiji gɛ.
Nyo gɛ̀ bee wu jɛme lɛ,

content.text: “Kife kì chuule gɛ̀ to ki kojɛ, nnya bintuŋ wo le.
Juu chi mbvusɛ gɛ̀ kojɛ mɛ mbvusɛ wo.”

content: Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, mɛɛse le kife kì chuule, chinɛ le juu chi mbvusɛ.
Gɛ bee gee lo fiɛɛ fì taŋlo fi baŋe je yi muh mu gɛ. Bee gee noo wu lɛ keefɛ ba gê ba yɛ̂ŋ jialɛ chimi yi lɛme chesa le gɛ.

Geenɛ, bee le be dunyɛ fiesa bikwɛɛ biɛsa a jé le yichii lɛ bee le bamii ba lɛme ba Nyo. Bee le bee dunyɛ je yì bee kaane shɛ́ŋ baaŋ yi baŋgɛ ba bee yɛde le, bɛ sege mwɛɛ tɛɛme mo sege je nyume gɛ yu gɛ.

Bee ka be dunyɛ tɛ no bo suŋe bee, bɛ no bo leese bee yéh yi ncha le, bo ka shiŋshi baŋgɛ besa bo. Bee to bee kfuune ye yi lɛme le, bee jade bee che antaŋ bee lefe gɛ, be ja kife kimi le bee tu bee kwee jɛŋ.

Bee duunyi tɛ a je yi kinche kesa kì yuude le, bɛ no bee kee fiɛɛ kune Nyo, mo no bee kaane shɛ́ŋ, bɛ no bee kɛme muntele mù njoŋe fɛ bamii le. Bee chee bee bii no Kiyo ki Yuude duunyi bee le, bee koŋe bamii bɛ kiŋkoŋɛ kinchiɛɛŋ.
Bee to bee jɛme gɛh nyu njɛmɛ wù nchiɛɛŋ, bee gee mwɛɛ a bvuŋga bvu Nyo le. Bee to bee jiji kinche ki chaaŋ le ki nyume njɛ mwɛɛ mu jɛŋ mu a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ le bɛ mu a kibo kiŋkoŋo le.

Bee to bee duunyi tɛ bamii ba le bee, kɛnɛ bamii ŋgvuune bee, kɛnɛ bo ŋgvuune gɛ, kɛnɛ bo jɛme mwɛɛ mù mbefe kune bee kɛnɛ bo jɛme nyu mù njoŋe. Bamii to bo jode bee lɛ bee le bamii ba kinlɛlɛ, geenɛ bee nyu bamii ba nchiɛɛŋ.

Bamii to bo jade bo nyu njɛ bo kee gɛ bee gɛ, geenɛ bo kee bee chuule. Bee jade bee yɛne lɛ bee le wa baŋkfusa, geenɛ bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, bee le gɛh yu. Bamii to bo ja bo nyaa ŋgɛ bee le, geenɛ bo yuuyi gɛ bee gɛ.

Bee to bee nyu njɛ bamii ba le yii yii, geenɛ bee laŋe gɛh ye segechii, bee nyume njɛ bamii ba fuude, geenɛ bee gee bamii ba duude tuu bamii ba kwa lɛ. Bee to bee nyume nɛ njɛ gɛ bee kɛme fiɛɛ gɛ, geenɛ bee kɛme mwɛɛ munchii.
Bamii ba Kolɛŋ, bee le bee jɛmɛ wa bɛŋ le, bee baaŋ nyilɛ gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ. Bee le bee gwenyɛ tɛ muntele mwesa bee gɛɛ mu yɛsɛ fɛ bɛŋ le.
Bee baaŋ baŋɛ gɛ muntele mwesa fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ. Baŋe bɛŋ mwɛna fɛ bee le.
Njɛme bɛŋ le njɛ booŋ baŋ lɛ bɛŋ gêe gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bee ge fɛ bɛŋ le, bɛŋ gwênyɛ tɛ muntele mwɛna fɛ bee le.
Keefɛ muh wu mbɛmɛ shûu kikaa bɛ muh wù le gɛ muh mbɛmɛ gɛ
Keefɛ bɛŋ shûu kikaa bɛ bamii ba le gɛ ba mbɛmɛ gɛ. Taŋlo fiɛɛ fì chaaŋ bɛ fì befe jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ mu nyûme yi fiɛɛ le fimimia? N'yulɛ bɛ kijibɛ taŋlo kɛme kintaashɛ?
Taŋlo Kletu bɛ Bɛlial
bo nyume jwe wu mumwaa? Fiɛɛ fì taashi muh wu mbɛmɛ bɛ muh wù le gɛ muh wu mbɛmɛ gɛ le la?
Yeh yi kintanyɛ ki Nyo taŋlo yi kɛme la ki yi gê bɛ munyo mu yi woŋ kfunɛ le? Bɛŋ kêe lɛ besabɛŋ le yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo yi kɛme kinche. Finɛ fiɛɛ le no Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nlé ŋgê nchêe yi bo le, njîɛnyi a bo ntɛnɛɛ.

content: Noo, Tada duu lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bû a bo antɛnɛɛ, bɛŋ nyûme yeye a bo le.
Keefɛ bɛŋ kûŋ fiɛɛ fì nyiɛŋ le gɛ,
bɛŋ nyume booŋ baŋ ba bilɛŋsɛ mo ba bikɛse.
Finɛ jɛme Tada wù Kɛme Bvuŋga Bvuchii.”

footnotes.text: Bɛlial wunɛ a jɛ́ yi Glek le, le lɛ Sataŋ.
